name: deskpet-guard
description: Monitor AI agents for suspicious exfiltration (encrypted workspace bundles, object-storage egress, secret-file touches) on Windows. Append-only event log; termination requires two-step human confirmation, one target per confirmation.

description_i18n.en: Monitor AI agents for suspicious exfiltration (encrypted workspace bundles, object-storage egress, secret-file touches) on Windows. Append-only event log; termination requires two-step human confirmation, one target per confirmation.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 跨 agent 监控可疑外传行为（加密打包、对象存储直连、密钥被触达）；事件写入只追加日志；终止进程需两步人工确认，一次只针对一个目标。
